desc: The all-new Browning X-Bolt 2 Pro models have been developed to push the boundaries of what a factory bolt-action rifle can be. Driven by a combination of field-proven performance and the newest in technology, Pro rifles are engineered to be lightweight and offer the accuracy you need when the moment of truth presents itself broadside. This premium rifle features a carbon fiber stock that designed to be both strong and light. Wrapped carbon fiber construction enhances the rigidity and durability. Rather than aluminum, the action is bedded into a compression molded carbon fiber bedding block to ensure the barrel is free floating. Noise dampening foam inside the hollow body of the stock helps prevent unwanted noise. To ensure correct eye-to-scope alignment — even with large optics — the comb offers easy height adjustment over a 1" range in precise 1/8" increments. 1/2", 1/4", and 1/8" spacers make length of pull adjustments simple to accommodate for shooter size or clothing layers. Shooting comfort duties are ably handled by Browning's own Inflex recoil pad that is now in a 1-1/4" thickness for improved felt recoil reduction. An integrated Picatinny rail at the tip of the fore-end makes bipod installation easy, as does the flush-fit QD sling swivel cups.
